_meta.name: credential-registry
_meta.purpose: Machine-readable CATALOGUE of known providers and the exact env var name(s) each one needs. Read by scripts/preflight-credentials.mjs to scope the credential gate to the locked run_state path.
_meta.IMPORTANT_this_is_a_catalogue_not_a_stac: Listing a provider here does NOT mean FNNL Agency uses it. This file answers 'if you chose tool X, which env vars does it need'. WHICH tools FNNL actually uses is declared ONLY in outbound/stack-contract.yaml, which ships empty. Never infer FNNL's stack from this catalogue.
_meta.how_to_use: /stack-setup records the chosen tool in stack-contract.yaml, then copies that provider's env var names from here into .env.example. A provider present here but absent from the contract is simply a tool FNNL has not chosen.
_meta.ownership_split: This registry + preflight own credential PRESENCE + SHAPE. /api-cost-governance owns BALANCE + SPEND. Shared registry, no duplicated logic.
_meta.secret_hygiene: Names + shapes only. NEVER stores or echoes a secret value. The preflight prints only present/MISSING/malformed or a masked last-4 tail.
_meta.provenance: Env var names were verified against a working upstream workspace. They are believed correct but have NOT been verified against FNNL's own accounts or plan tiers. Confirm on first real call.

tiers.always: Needed by every send flow. Default enforcement: fail (overridable per provider).
tiers.stack-registrar: Required by run_state.registrar. Default enforcement: fail.
tiers.stack-mailbox: Required by run_state.mailbox_provider. Default enforcement: fail.
tiers.platform: Required by run_state.sending_platform. Default enforcement: fail.
tiers.crm: CRM sync tool, only when a CRM is set in the stack contract. Default enforcement: warn (optional layer).
tiers.source: Lead-source tool key, only when that source is the recorded choice. Default enforcement: warn.
tiers.ai-optional: AI routing keys (ai-model-routing). Have fallbacks. Default enforcement: warn.

spaceship.label: Spaceship (registrar)
spaceship.note: Both key AND secret required. spaceship-mcp env (.mcp.json:7-8); spaceship-*-domain-setup; .env.example:29-30.

spaceship_contacts.label: Spaceship registration contact IDs
spaceship_contacts.note: Registration config, not an auth credential. Warn-level: the spaceship setup skill enforces these at registration time. .env.example:31-34.

zapmail.label: Zapmail (mailbox provider)
zapmail.note: zapmail MCP env (.mcp.json:23); .env.example:40-42 (ZAPMAIL_MCP_API_KEY alias); kickoff pre-fill ZAPMAIL_TOKEN alias (kickoff:122).

primeforge.label: Primeforge (mailbox provider / native registrar)
primeforge.note: Multi-field trigger: covers BOTH mailbox_provider=Primeforge and the primeforge_native registrar=Primeforge (same key). salesforge MCP header X-Primeforge-Key (.mcp.json:30); .env.example:68.

emailbison.label: EmailBison (sending platform)
emailbison.note: Also needs an instance URL: run_state.emailbison_instance_url OR EMAILBISON_BASE_URL/EMAILBISON_INSTANCE_URL. EmailBison is HTTP (not in .mcp.json). emailbison-api:25-26; kickoff:116-119.

smartlead.label: Smartlead (sending platform)
smartlead.note: smartlead MCP env (.mcp.json:15); kickoff:118; smartlead-api skill.

instantly.label: Instantly (sending platform)
instantly.note: kickoff pre-fill (kickoff:118). No dedicated skill/MCP in repo yet.

getsales.label: GetSales.io (sending / sequencing platform)
getsales.note: Basic v0.1 (2026-06-24) — default-stack sending platform for FORKED workspaces; the upstream workspace sends via Smartlead/EmailBison so this never triggers for the upstream workspace. REST base https://amazing.getsales.io (api.getsales.io = docs host only); auth Authorization: Bearer <JWT> from Workspace Settings -> API Keys; 300 req/min. Tool scripts/getsales.mjs; local MCP scripts/mcp/getsales-mcp-server.mjs; official hosted MCP https://mcp.getsales.io (OAuth custom connector). Warn-level: only when sending_platform=GetSales.io. Live-untested (no account yet). Skill /getsales-io.

close.label: Close.com (CRM)
close.note: Basic v0.1 (2026-06-24) — default-stack CRM layer for FORKED workspaces; the upstream workspace has no CRM step so this never triggers for the upstream workspace. REST base https://api.close.com/api/v1; auth HTTP Basic with the api_ key as username + blank password; singular trailing-slash paths. Tool scripts/close.mjs; local MCP scripts/mcp/close-mcp-server.mjs; official hosted MCP https://mcp.close.com/mcp (headers Close-API-Key + Close-Scope mcp.read|write_safe|write_destructive). Warn-level under the crm tier; only when run_state.crm=Close.com. Live-untested (no account yet). Skill /close-crm.

millionverifier.label: Email verifier (MillionVerifier)
millionverifier.enforcement_reason: Adopted name, in no repo file. api-cost-governance:68 lists verification as one of several interchangeable tools (A-Leads / Prospeo / WizLeads / MillionVerifier), so no single verifier key is unconditionally required; hard-failing on this specific key would false-block an operator who verifies another way. Also only needed at the list stage, not at kickoff. User decision 2026-06-08: warn, not fail.
millionverifier.note: Email verification (email-only — does NOT do catch-all). The verify-first half of /email-waterfall; pair with a catch-all tool (bounceban) or use a two-in-one (enrichly). Promote to enforcement:fail only after a canonical env var is adopted into .env.example AND a consumer reads it.

bounceban.label: BounceBan (catch-all / accept-all verification)
bounceban.enforcement_reason: Catch-all verification partner for /email-waterfall's verify-first step — pairs with any email-only verifier (A-Leads / MillionVerifier / Reoon / LeadMagic). One of several interchangeable verify paths (the other being the two-in-one Enrichly), so a missing key must not hard-block an operator who verifies another way. Only needed at the live-slice verify stage, not at kickoff. Warn, not fail. User decision 2026-06-16.
bounceban.note: ⚠ RETIRED — no longer required. Deliverable.co does catch-all built-in (is_catch_all), so the separate BounceBan pass is superseded (2026-06-16). Was the catch-all partner for A-Leads verify, which is also retired. No key in .env; do NOT wire.

enrichly.label: Enrichly (two-in-one email verification + catch-all)
enrichly.enforcement_reason: Single-tool alternative to the A-Leads+BounceBan verify-first pair — does email verification AND catch-all in one call. Interchangeable with the other verify paths, so warn not fail; only needed at the live-slice verify stage. User decision 2026-06-16.
enrichly.note: Two-in-one verify+catch-all. ⚠ RETIRED — superseded by Deliverable.co as the chosen verifier (2026-06-16). No key in .env.

deliverable.label: Deliverable.co (email verification + catch-all — THE verifier)
deliverable.enforcement_reason: THE email-verification tool for /email-waterfall (operator directive 2026-06-16 — A-Leads verify + BounceBan retired). Two-in-one: deliverability + catch-all in one call. Warn not fail — verification only runs at the live-slice verify stage, not at kickoff. User decision 2026-06-16.
deliverable.note: A-Leads sub-product (app.deliverable.co). REST async: POST /verify/single {email}->task_id, poll POST /verify/single/status {task_id}->{email_status, is_catch_all}; bulk file path is a SLOW queue. Auth x-api-key header. Base https://api.deliverable.co/gateway. NO balance endpoint (402=out of credits). Two-in-one (email_status + is_catch_all) so NO separate catch-all tool needed. Tool scripts/deliverable_verify.mjs. KEY IN .env 2026-06-16 (len 32, VERIFIED LIVE). Replaces A-Leads verify + BounceBan + Enrichly + MillionVerifier/Reoon/LeadMagic for verification.

reoon.label: Reoon (email verification)
reoon.enforcement_reason: Email-only verifier (no catch-all) — same posture as MillionVerifier; pair with BounceBan for catch-all. Warn, not fail. User decision 2026-06-16.
reoon.note: Email verification (email-only — does NOT do catch-all). Pair with bounceban. Consumer: /email-waterfall. No key in .env yet (2026-06-16).

bettercontact.label: BetterContact (waterfall email/phone enrichment; built-in check is a provider signal, NOT the send-gate)
bettercontact.enforcement_reason: Layer-2 contact-enrichment provider and the recommended default for /email-waterfall, but one of several interchangeable enrichment tools (BetterContact / Prospeo / A-Leads / WizLeads / Blitz) — a missing key must not hard-block an operator who enriches another way. Only needed at the live-slice enrichment stage, not at kickoff. Warn, not fail — same posture as the verifier key. User decision 2026-06-13.
bettercontact.note: REST async waterfall: POST /api/v2/async (submit 1-100) then GET /api/v2/async/{id} (poll status in_progress->terminated). Auth = X-API-Key HEADER (NOT Authorization: Bearer). No official MCP (only third-party Composio/Make/Pipedream wrappers). Consumer: scripts/bettercontact_enrich.mjs + /email-waterfall; .env.example enrichment section. Live balance = GET /api/v2/account -> credits_left (owned by /api-cost-governance, not the preflight --validate path, which assumes Bearer). NOTE: BetterContact's built-in 4-layer check is a provider signal, NOT the send-gate — every BetterContact-found email is still re-verified through Deliverable.co before sending (operator directive 2026-06-22; no source is exempt; routing owned by /email-waterfall).

prospeo.label: Prospeo (lead source)
prospeo.note: prospeo-full-export / prospeo-search-api skills. Checked only if Prospeo is the recorded lead source.

competitor_engagers.label: Competitor engagers (RapidAPI + OpenRouter)
competitor_engagers.note: competitor-engagers skill (RapidAPI LinkedIn bulk data + OpenRouter).

aleads.label: A-Leads (company search + contact enrichment)
aleads.note: ⚠ SUPERSEDED 2026-06-16: A-Leads is now reached via the A-Leads MCP connector (https://mcp.a-leads.co, a Claude custom connector — NOT this env key); all 9 tools incl. verify_email live-verified working, so the REST 500/403 below is resolved and the REST key is legacy-fallback-only (see /aleads-api). REST history: REST API uses TWO auth modes: x-api-key HEADER for search/company endpoints, api_key IN THE JSON BODY for bulk file-management (get-all-bulk-files, get-bulk-file). Key AUTHENTICATES (wrong key=401); account healthy (custom plan + credits, web app used same day, .env key matches dashboard exactly). As of 2026-06-12: bulk file-management WORKS (200); but every search/enrichment EXECUTION endpoint 500s after auth (sync company-search/find-email/etc. AND bulk-advanced-search/company-search/bulk), plus 403 on reverse-email-lookup + find-email/personal. Root cause of the 500 is OPEN — provisioning gap OR an undocumented submit requirement (the live API already diverges from its spec: the api_key-in-body auth is nowhere in the spec). Resolve via the A-Leads developer (neutral handoff message in the skill's Account Activation / Developer handoff section), NOT a guessed support ask. Run scripts/aleads-selftest.mjs to recheck (--submit also fires bulk-advanced-search).

leadmagic.label: LeadMagic (lead source + email validator incl. catch-all + contact enricher)
leadmagic.note: Triple role: lead source, email validator, AND contact enricher. Its /email-validate endpoint does deliverability validation WITH catch-all detection in one call (the response returns email_status = valid|invalid|unknown PLUS a separate is_domain_catch_all boolean), and the same tool returns contact/company enrichment fields. So LeadMagic is the default validator+enricher in a candidate for the email_verification and contact_enrichment slots (operator directive 2026-06-24; supersedes the old 'email-only, no catch-all, pair with BounceBan' framing). The upstream workspace verified via Deliverable.co; LeadMagic's catch-all only matters when a forked workspace lacks Deliverable.co access. The LeadMagic Smartlead MCP is read-only; the validator/enricher uses LEADMAGIC_API_KEY (NOT in .env, so the catch-all capability is doc-confirmed against the LeadMagic API reference but unverified-live). Warn-level.

discolike.label: DiscoLike (lead source)
discolike.note: Lookalike-company discovery spine for /lead-source-strategy + /tam-build (used WITH or INSTEAD of A-Leads — both are operator-choice primary spines, NOT fallbacks). Reached via the DiscoLike MCP connector (no .env key, like A-Leads). CATALOGUED PROVIDERS — a must for the list build, NOT optional. (env [] is correct: it's a connector, so the preflight key-check can't gate it — set it up in Claude -> Connectors.)

openai.label: OpenAI (QA / images)
openai.note: ai_router.mjs:89; .env.example:65. QA routing + gpt-image-1 headshots. CATALOGUED PROVIDERS — expected on a real run (NOT optional): generates the sender headshot (gpt-image-1) + QA/gap-fill; MiniMax substitutes for image-gen only. Warn-level = graceful degradation if missing, not 'skip it'.

deepseek.label: DeepSeek (bulk crunch)
deepseek.note: ai_router.mjs:90; .env.example:56. Free balance endpoint -> usable for --validate. CATALOGUED PROVIDERS — the full-TAM ICP-fit-classification workhorse (on-disk batch); MiniMax is the crunch fallback. Warn-level = graceful degradation, NOT optional.

perplexity.label: Perplexity (web research)
perplexity.enforcement_reason: Warn-level under the DEFAULT research_routing=claude_deep_research (operator directive 2026-07-02): the primary research pass is the Claude native /deep-research fan-out harness, which needs no third-party key, so a missing Perplexity key only drops an optional gap-fill grounding pass. preflight ELEVATES this to REQUIRED (hard-stop) ONLY when research_routing is an explicit third_party_ai opt-out, where Perplexity is the chosen primary and its key becomes a credential hard-stop. research_primary:true is the flag preflight keys that conditional elevation on (it means 'the third-party research primary', not 'the default primary').
perplexity.note: ai_router.mjs:87; .env.example:58. Warn-level under the default claude_deep_research (native /deep-research primary needs no 3rd-party key); preflight requires the key ONLY under an explicit third_party_ai opt-out.

grok.label: Grok / xAI (social research)
grok.note: ai_router.mjs:88 (XAI_API_KEY or GROK_API_KEY); .env.example:57. CATALOGUED PROVIDERS — powers the X/social signal reads in the VOC/discovery pipeline; the ONE documented 'reason' it isn't hard-required is that a campaign with no social angle can skip the spend (Perplexity is the research default). Have the key; it's not a throwaway optional.

serper.label: Serper (Google Search)
serper.note: ai_router.mjs:150; .env.example:60. CATALOGUED PROVIDERS — the default cheap Google-search/URL-discovery provider (DiscoGen search + VOC URL-finding + tam enrichment signals); broadly used across discovery. Warn-level = graceful degradation, NOT optional.

spider.label: Spider Cloud (page extraction)
spider.note: HTTP MCP at https://mcp.spider.cloud/mcp (Authorization: Bearer). 22 tools (8 core, 5 AI, 9 browser). ai_router.mjs:173; .env.example:61. CATALOGUED PROVIDERS — the default web crawler/extractor; in /tam-build it's escalation-only (cheap text-classify runs first) with a Serper-snippet crawl-fail fallback — that's the documented 'reason' it stays warn, NOT optional.

stack_map_note: Known registrar+mailbox pairings from the upstream workspace, kept so /stack-setup can offer them as options. FNNL's actual pairing lives in stack-contract.yaml under infrastructure.infrastructure_stack. An entry here is an option, never a default.
